description_en: Updates the notification status in batches
name: BatchUpdateNoticeStatus

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and the received message. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
指定请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The list of primary key identifiers to be synchronized to Certificate Management Service. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 待同步到证书服务的主键标识列表。多个ID使用半角逗号（,）间隔

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable message notification.
--enable: enables message notification.
--disable: disables message notification
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启消息通知。
--enable：开启。
--disable：关闭

parameters.help_en: The business code of message notification. The value is fixed as ssl
parameters.help_zh: 消息通知的业务编码。此处固定为ssl
